name: Retrieval Evaluation Harness
purpose: SELECTION-POLICY OWNER + eval harness. Authors the ONE versioned DETERMINISTIC selection-policy library `selpol_rrf_v1` (lib/selpol_rrf_v1.py; CONTEXT_PACKET_CONTRACT s4 / P1-1, D-0087; PINNED D-0089) -- OWNED here, CONSUMED by the context compiler #40 AND by this harness's own A/B, so there is exactly ONE selection owner (removing the two-reranker problem). i32 (D-0092) folds the CONTEXT_PACKET_CONTRACT i32 amendment into selpol_rrf_v1 1.0.0->1.1.0 (ADDITIVE, 1.0.0-default byte-identical): (U1) `hard_filter_namespace` -- `params.allowed_namespaces` is a HARD boundary that SINKS a cross-namespace candidate and RETIRES the soft namespace/project-match bonus; (U4) under the resolved `current_only` mode a non-`current` candidate (MEMORY_CONTRACT s5) is HARD-filtered `hard_filter_stale` (the soft `stale_penalty` survives ONLY for the non-current_only `prefer_current` mode), supersession is rank-affecting (`superseded_demote` orders a superseded record strictly below its live successor), and a `contradicts` edge between two selected current items is PROPAGATED (surfaced, not detected) for #40's `conflicted`; (U5) a `query_class` drives the temporal mode deterministically (a Tier-0 stub) and the retriever channel set stays OPEN (an explicit `retrieval_occurrences[]` fuses a novel channel with NO code change). eval 0.3->0.4 adds a `selection_conformance` block MEASURING namespace isolation, current_only correctness, supersession ordering, and reason-code coverage (integer-only, byte-identical on re-run). select(candidates, descriptor, policy_id, params) -> {selected[], ranked[], policy_id, policy_version, features_by_candidate, omission_manifest[]}; PURE + deterministic (no model/IO/state); stages: hard filters -> temporal stale-demote (s5) -> authority (epistemic_authority) -> versioned RRF over CHANNEL RANKS (retrieval_occurrences[], not cross-query raw scores; P1-2) -> occurrence-preserving DISPLAY dedup (identical text -> one display item + occurrences[] + evidence_cluster_id, provenance NEVER erased; P1-3) -> budget. Output is ADDITIVE: preserves retrieval_rank/lexical_rank/vector_rank/fused_rank and adds selection_rank/selection_score/selection_policy_id/selected/reason_codes -- it never re-sorts the retrieval array in place. The shipped standalone rerank() is now a THIN WRAPPER over this library (the measured A/B measures the library; the shipped 0.2 benchmark + A/B stay regression-green byte-for-byte at the metric-value level). eval-0.3 also scores PER STAGE (raw retrieval / post-filter / packet) + packet_disposition correctness (answerable|needs_expansion|abstain|conflicted|provenance_failed -- read from a supplied #40 packet or computed deterministically), and marks hybrid metrics not_applicable (NOT zero) while the vector channel is EMPTY (P1-4; full graded-relevance P1-4 is a named follow-on). Make retrieval + packet quality MEASURABLE against the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT s6 evaluation gates (D-0083; eval-0.2/0.3, i29/i30). Runs a benchmark (schema lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2; the 0.1 schema is still accepted for regression) against ANY retriever satisfying the MEMORY_CONTRACT s3 retriever-0.2 interface (op search; inputs {query,k,filters?}; result = a ranked hit array in deterministic order; hit = span OBJECT {start,end}+span_label, record_id/record_version_id/record_kind, content_hash [SOURCE VERSION identity], status/currentness+authority_level, and per-channel diagnostics: retrieval_channels, lexical_rank+lexical_score, vector_rank+vector_similarity [null until vectors], fused_rank+fused_score, fusion_algo+fusion_version, embedding_space_id, index_snapshot/corpus_version, filter_decisions, tie_break_key). The retriever-0.1 hit shape (span string + opaque score) is still accepted (compat/migration). Ships its OWN deterministic LEXICAL BASELINE (BM25-lite over a fully-known fixture corpus, emitting retriever-0.2 hits, score_unit millionths) AND an external_command adapter (the seam the orchestrator points at the real artifact.search #36 at fold). eval-0.2 LABELS: must_include_all/must_include_any evidence groups, required version/span, acceptable-equivalent spans, explicitly-stale versions, forbidden_sources, hard privacy exclusions, distractors, no_answer_expected, label rationale/status/reviewer, corpus snapshot -- a FILE-level hit is NOT credit (chunk/span level matching). TEMPORAL INTENT per query (current_only|historical_as_of|version_specific|any_valid_version; 'a stale required source is always a miss' holds ONLY for current_only). METRICS: recall@K, MRR (kept) + precision@K, nDCG@K, evidence-group coverage, forbidden/privacy/stale-hit rate, duplicate/near-dup burden, source diversity, provenance VALIDITY (not presence), snippet-span correctness, relevant-token ratio, no-answer false-positive rate, hybrid uplift/regression. PROVENANCE VALIDATION: content_hash identifies the expected source version; the source exists or is tombstoned; the span is in bounds; reading the span reproduces the cited text; the snippet derives from it; the parser+chunker fingerprint is known; current/stale status is correct. HYBRID ATTRIBUTION from the retriever-0.2 per-channel diagnostics (lexical-only/vector-only/hybrid); the vector channel runs EMPTY today and is reported cleanly. A DETERMINISTIC RERANKER (directive 8.3 / skill-activation Stage 4; NO model) takes the retriever-0.2 hit array + a task/query descriptor and returns the SAME hit-array shape reordered by deterministic features (direct relevance, authority, freshness/currentness, project/component match, task-stage match, failure likelihood, procedural applicability) + DIVERSITY; the harness MEASURES it (rerank uplift/regression vs the raw order + per-query rescue/demote). Emits TWO deterministic reports -- report.json (machine, schema lifeorch.retrieval_eval_report/0.2) and report.md (human) -- both canonical (UTF-8 no BOM, sorted keys, integer-only: scores millionths, ratios ppm; no timestamps/invocation-ids/absolute-paths/latency), byte-identical on a re-run across machines (query latency/resource live in the volatile worker-summary.json, never the report). content_hash is EOL-normalized so a CRLF vs LF checkout hashes identically. Thin pwsh wrapper over a stdlib-only Python worker (retrieval_eval.py). CPU-only, no model, no CUDA, no network -> parallel_safe:true.

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -InputFile <benchmark.json> (a lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2 or /0.1 file) OR -InputsJson '<json {benchmark|input: path-or-inline-object, corpus_dir?, provenance_corpus_dir?, retriever?, k_values?, retrieval_depth?, base_dir?, python_path?, worker_path?}>'. Also: -CorpusDir, -RetrieverJson '<spec json>', -KValues <int[]>, -RetrievalDepth <int>, -BaseDir <dir>, -PythonPath, -WorkerPath, -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId. Precedence: -InputFile > InputsJson.benchmark > InputsJson.input.

inputs.name: benchmark
inputs.description: The benchmark: a JSON file path (via -InputFile) or an inline lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.2 object (via -InputsJson.benchmark). {benchmark_id, corpus_dir?, provenance_corpus_dir?, retriever?, k_values?, retrieval_depth?, tombstones?, queries:[{query_id, query, temporal_intent?, required_sources:[{source_path, content_hash?, span?:{start,end}|string, span_label?, require_span?, chunk_id?, acceptable_spans?, must_reproduce_text?}], evidence_groups?:[{group_id, mode:all|any, members:[...]}], stale_sources?, forbidden_sources?, privacy_exclusions?, distractors?, no_answer_expected?, rerank_descriptor?:{namespace?, component?, task_stage?, seeking_failures?}, label_rationale?, label_status?, reviewer?, corpus_snapshot?, filters?}]}. The lifeorch.retrieval_benchmark/0.1 schema (required_sources/stale_sources/forbidden_sources only, span as a string) is still accepted (temporal_intent defaults to current_only).

inputs.name: corpus_dir
inputs.description: Override the lexical-baseline corpus directory (else benchmark.retriever.corpus_dir / benchmark.corpus_dir); resolved relative to base_dir. Also used as the provenance-validation corpus when provenance_corpus_dir is absent.

inputs.name: provenance_corpus_dir
inputs.description: The source-of-truth corpus that hits are VALIDATED against (s6 provenance validation). Defaults to corpus_dir / benchmark.corpus_dir / the lexical baseline's corpus. When absent entirely, provenance validity degrades to presence + format checks (reported as provenance_validated=false).

inputs.name: retriever
inputs.description: Override the retriever spec. kind=lexical_baseline {corpus_dir, k1?, b?, include_suffixes?, exclude_dir_names?} OR kind=external_command {argv:[...], request_via:stdin|file|arg, hits_pointer?='result.hits', timeout_seconds?} (the fold seam -> the real #36 artifact.search retriever-0.2). argv tokens {PYTHON}/{BASE_DIR}/{MODULE_ROOT}/{REQUEST_FILE}/{REQUEST_JSON} are substituted at call time. Hits are normalized (retriever-0.2 shape preferred; retriever-0.1 accepted).

inputs.name: k_values
inputs.description: The K set for recall@K / precision@K / nDCG@K / source-diversity@K (ints).

inputs.name: retrieval_depth
inputs.description: Max hits requested from the retriever per query (raised to at least max(k_values)).

inputs.name: base_dir
inputs.description: Directory used to resolve a relative corpus_dir / provenance_corpus_dir and external-retriever argv paths (default = the benchmark file's directory).

outputs.description: { benchmark_id, benchmark_schema, retriever_kind, num_queries, k_values, retrieval_depth, ratio_unit='ppm', provenance_validated, vector_channel_status, selection_policy{policy_id,policy_version,rrf_k,stages}, packet_disposition{scored,num_labeled,num_correct,accuracy_ppm}, selection_conformance{namespace_isolation_violations,current_only_stale_leaks,supersession_order_violations,supersession_pairs_total,queries_with_contradicts,reason_code_coverage_count} (i32/D-0092 eval-0.4), aggregate{raw retriever order: recall_at_k_ppm, recall_at_k_micro_ppm, precision_at_k_ppm, ndcg_at_k_ppm, source_diversity_at_k_ppm, mrr_ppm, evidence_group_coverage_ppm, stale_source_rate_ppm, stale_hit_rate_ppm, forbidden_hit_rate_ppm, privacy_hit_rate_ppm, judged_irrelevant_rate_ppm, duplicate_burden_ppm, relevant_token_ratio_ppm, provenance_completeness_ppm, provenance_validity_ppm, snippet_span_correctness_ppm, no_answer_false_positive_rate_ppm, queries_all_required_present, ...}, aggregate_reranked{same, on the reranked/post-filter order}, aggregate_packet{same, on the packet-stage selection}, stage_metrics{raw,post_filter,packet}, rerank_ab{queries_with_rescue, queries_with_demote, deltas{ndcg/precision/recall/evidence-group/forbidden/stale}}, report_json{path,sha256,bytes}, report_md{path,sha256,bytes}, input_digest }. Artifacts: report.json (lifeorch.retrieval_eval_report/0.4 -- canonical, deterministic, machine-readable: selection_policy + selection_conformance (i32/D-0092) + hybrid_applicability + aggregate_raw + aggregate_reranked + aggregate_packet + stage_metrics + rerank_ab + rerank_diagnostics + hybrid_attribution + packet_disposition_eval + per_query_raw + per_query_reranked + per_query_packet + per_query_selection_conformance, each per-query carrying matched@K/recall@K/precision@K/nDCG@K/evidence groups/stale+wrong-version hits/forbidden+privacy+distractor hits/no-answer FP/returned-with-provenance-validity + the ADDITIVE selection fields retrieval_rank/selection_rank/selection_score/selection_policy_id/selected/reason_codes/evidence_cluster_id/occurrence_count), report.md (human), worker-summary.json (carries the VOLATILE query latency/resource). On failure the envelope is status=error with a structured error and no reports.
